headline: Pakistan and Oman Sign Petroleum Products and Credit Line Accord
summary: Pakistan State Oil signed an agreement with Oman's OQ Trading to purchase petroleum products backed by a $200 million credit facility, helping diversify energy sourcing.
why: Cross-border energy supply agreements affect national trade deficits, currency stability, and regional logistics for state-backed energy corporations.

impacts.name: Pakistan State Oil
impacts.why: Secures an international petroleum supply agreement and financing credit line.
